name: FA_RETIREMENT_DISTS_T
description: FA_RETIREMENT_DISTS_T contains asset distribution details for unit retirements entered in the retirements interface table.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Retirement interface identifier.

columns.name: LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Line identifier. Combined with the interface line number to identify the parent and distribution line.

columns.name: UNITS_RETIRED
columns.description: Number of units of asset retired. Must be a whole number.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Distribution identifier. Use an Assets work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Depreciation expense account identifier. Use the Manage Account Combinations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location of the asset. Use the Manage Asset locations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO
columns.description: Employee identification number. Use the Manage Resources task to identify valid values.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
